notes.title: Patch 5.4 is now live!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi everyone![/h2]

Here is [i]Atlas Fallen: Reign of Sand[/i]'s latest patch. Make sure you read the entire note!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850092/575ec4c0332bc14811be79aa53c53df0bdcb7ae5.jpg[/img]

[h2]PERFORMANCE[/h2]
Added an experimental option to fix the stutters that players with uncapped FPS suffered when playing with high frequency monitors (requires more powerful PCs and changes to settings.json file).

This allows you to manually set the rate at which all game systems are updated (including camera movement, which was the main culprit for the stuttery feeling encountered at high framerate).

[h3]How to enable the fix:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Download the file available on Focus Together [url=https://community.focus-entmt.com/focus-entertainment/atlas-fallen/blogs/98-patch-5-4-is-now-live]here[/url]
[*] Replace your settings file with the pre-made one you just downloaded, it will activate the fix, but it will reset all the rest of your options to defaults.
[/list]
[h3]Formatting tips:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Make sure to respect the formatting of the json file (spaces, tabulations ...etc.).
[*] If you add the line in the middle of the text block, don't forget the comma at the end of it. It will not work without it.
[*] If the line that you add is the last line, it doesn't need a comma at the end.
[/list]
[h3] Warnings & Guidelines:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The higher you set the value, the more resource intensive the game will become, which can lead to potential slowdowns.
[*] We advise to try this experimental fix only if your system specs are vastly above the recommended specs for the game.
[*] If you want to try the fix, we advise to first set the setting's value to a framerate that your machine can hit most of the time in game (for example, if your machine can play the game at an average of 100 fps, even in intensive situations, then you can start with the setting's value to 100).
[*] If the game doesn't behave well with a high value, reducing it should help performance (for example, if a value of 100 leads to slowdowns, you can try 90 or 80, and adjust based on your tests' results).
[*] On the contrary, if the game runs well with the value that you set, then you can try to progressively crank up the value, to reach the smoothest experience possible.
[*] If you want to go back to the default behavior of the game, simply put the value to 60 (default), or delete the line from the settings file.
[/list]
[h2]STABILITY[/h2]
[list]
[*] In some rare cases, when the EOS matchmaking option is enabled, crash may happen when quitting the game or going into co-op mode. If that happens, disabling the EOS matchmaking option should fix the issue.
[*] Fixed a crash that happened with specific SteamDeck settings changes
[*] Fixed an issue that caused players to have a black screen during one of the tutorials
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Corruption Breach events to end when playing in co-op and the host dies
[*] Fixed a crash that happens when disconnecting from co-op sessions after one of the player dies
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the game to stop responding after players change both the frame and refresh rate to 30 under specific conditions
[*] Fixed a crash that happened when reloading save files multiple times at a specific location
[*] Improved stability on XBSS: Fixed an issue that caused the game to crash when players died repeatedly
[/list]
[h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the Essence Stone “Saving Grace” to not work properly
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the “Idol of Salvation” to not work properly
[*] Fixed an issue that caused two audio logs to be duplicated
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the Knuckledust weapon to be unavailable during NG+ under specific conditions
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the Knuckledust weapon and loadout presets to be unlocked at the wrong time when converting save files from the base game that were at a specific point in the game
[*] Fixed an issue that caused chests to not be displayed correctly when at a Vantage Point
[*] Fixed an issue in which specific items would not get awarded to co-op partners upon collecting them thus preventing getting 100% of the game and/or certain achievements/trophies 
[*] Fixed an issue that caused enemies to stop attacking players after starting NG+
[*] Fixed an issues where players could skip the save conversion process from base game into Reign of Sand edition leading to further issues
[*] Fixed an issue that caused certain bosses to take extra damage in NG+ 
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the player character to no longer take damage after rekindling a specific boss fight
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the achievement/trophy “Forgemaster” to not unlock for guest players under specific conditions in co-op
[*] Adjusted the cost for weapon upgrades in NG+
[*] Fixed an issue that caused players to be blocked if they used up all of their essence before reaching the locked sockets tutorial
[/list]
[h2]VISUAL[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the healing VFX of the Essence Stone (Beastial Claws) to remain on screen 
[*] Fixed a visual issue that caused several artifacts when Idol and Shatter Attacks were used multiple times in quick succession.
[*] Fixed a visual issue that caused options in the Anvil Menu to be grayed out when they shouldn’t (and the opposite for when they shouldn’t)
[*] Fixed a visual issue that caused the Anvil menu to display a broken reference under specific conditions
[/list]
[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the profile name on XBOX to not be properly displayed when changing languages
[*] Fixed an UI issue that caused icons in the save file to display a broken reference upon dying and reloading
[*] Fixed an UI issue that displayed the wrong option for opening chests 
[*] Fixed an UI issue that caused the “rekindle” option to not be available after completing a challenge
[*] Fixed an issue that caused certain tutorial prompts to not be displayed properly under specific conditions
[*] Fixed an issue that caused tutorials in NG+ to not be displayed properly
[/list]

notes.title: A new update is available now! (Patch 5.3)
notes.content:

We're happy to present you a brand new update of ​[i]Atlas Fallen: Reign of San​d[/i]! You shall find the list of changes here:

[*] Addition of Code-based matchmaking support on the PC Gamepass / Microsoft Store version, to allow for easier co-op with Steam & EGS players.
[/list]
[h2]Stability / Technical fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fix for freezes & crashes that happened when completing a large number of Source Trials (via the Rekindling functionality). Savefiles that were affected by this bug should be fully usable again.
[*] Memory Optimizations to increase general stability during long play sessions, for all platforms & game modes.
[/list]
[h2]Balancing:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that would sometimes cause the Fallen King boss to be extremely weak.
[*] Fixed an exploit that allowed players to become completely invulnerable via a specific build.
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]

[h3]Co-op:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix for a co-op bug that locked players in the final dialogue of the Source quest if they used characters of different genders.
[*] Fix for a savefile corruption that happened when an advanced NG+ Guest joined an early-game NG+ Host, and picked the “Save Character” option after exiting the session.
[*] Fixed a blocking co-op bug that permanently locked the character in place when dying while the co-op partner defeated the Source’s Final Boss.
[*] Fixed a bug that would prevent players from rekindling Source Trials in co-op, under specific conditions.
[*] Fixed Corruption Breaches despawning if the co-op Host died two times in a row while doing them.
[*] Fix for a co-op issue that caused shoppable items to become irretrievable for the Guest, if the Host had bought them before launching co-op.

[h3]Audio:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed audio issue that caused one of Nyaal’s barks to be very loud and hard to understand.
[*] Fixed audio file not playing for “The Lost Caravan” lore item.
[/list]

[h3]Enemies:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix for an issue that caused greater & colossal enemies to turn invincible when targeted by a support ability of the Weaver wraith at a specific time.
[*] Fix for an issue that caused the Sand Clones of the Marauder Enemies to be invisible.

[h3]Visual / UI:[/h3]
Fix for the rendering of armors breaking when quickly scrolling through several armor models.
[list]
[*] Fixed issues that would happen with the Compass when dying during Source boss fights.
[*] Added UI popup for the distribution of the “Celestial Damage” NG+ essence stone, that could easily be missed.
[*] Added functional counter for the discovered Source Portals on the Source Map.
[/list]

[h3]Misc:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix for camera issues when getting hit or killed while interacting with a Source Portal.
[*] Fixed Localization issues in the Credits.
[/list]

notes.title: The Atlas Fallen Reign of Sand free, major update is LIVE!
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome back, everyone! ✨[/h2]

The free major update of Atlas Fallen Reign of Sand is now [b]available[/b]! You are back in the Sand to discover new environments, enemies, difficulty mode, voice cast... and more! ⌛

Get ready to conquer the Source and its [b]tremendous mysteries[/b]! 💥

Watch [b]Reign of Sand's launch trailer[/b] below:
[previewyoutube=0DFm6TolJY4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]All-new Challenge area: the Source[/h2]

Explore the very fabric of God’s limbo and wield new powers in various epic challenges.
During your exploration, you’ll encounter [b]special Rifts[/b] across the world. Interacting with these portals allows you to enter [b]the Source[/b] as [b]Nyaal[/b]. In this seemingly endless desert teeming with shattered giant structures you’ll face new challenges and unearth key elements that help you better understand the past.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850092/f7efc4ebeb4c3935a76d737ce316844b675b24c1.gif[/img]

The Source features exciting combat centered around the new gameplay mechanic of [b][i]Wraith Abilities[/i][/b]. Within the limbo, you’ll unlock wraith-like powers, allowing you to master the sand like never before.
[list][*] [b]Transform into a Shellshocker[/b] and unleash a devastating tornado that damages enemies and generates momentum.
[*] [b]Morph into a Mawer[/b] to perform a forward dash, damaging opponents as you pass through them.[/list]
Combine these new abilities with swift sand surfing to overcome this menacing sand limbo. Each challenge provides rewards and uncovers previously untold story fragments related to the War of Gods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850092/281b61bda3177e7c663fc005032e2b4f165b1cb5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850092/0e20f596daac95e9a9f455f7af4b414859e35cc2.jpg[/img]

[h2]New monsters join the cast![/h2]

New threats emerge in the world of [i]Atlas Fallen[/i]! With Reign of Sand, we aim to offer you [b]a refined combat experience and unique challenges to overcome[/b]. A diverse range of enemies is crucial to convey a satisfying sense of progression and ensure a consistently fresh gameplay experience. So, let’s introduce some of our new Wraith Challengers!

[b][h3]Morpher[/h3][/b]
[table] [tr]
[td] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850092/84c09c63b72153cd78a94502cfe8961f9413f8d6.jpg[/img][/td]
[td] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850092/f2f59cc73868b401a34646605e354f0cc05988c7.jpg[/img] [/td]
[/tr] [/table]
The Morpher is a [b]nimble new Wraith[/b] that challenges you [b]both in the air and on the ground[/b]. While airborne, this foe attacks with swift strikes focused on speed and mobility. In contrast, it resorts to powerful melee attacks when grounded.

These two distinct behaviors require you to adapt on the fly to stand a chance.

[b][h3]Transmuter[/h3][/b]
[table] [tr]
[td] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850092/7dd6c18d1d2a325c2f84f124b11512d0794ac9c8.jpg[/img] [/td]
[td] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850092/e9a25746a609ecf4bcee7560a42af48e04e7f665.jpg[/img] [/td]
[/tr] [/table]
Prepare to face this bulky Wraith capable of devastating strikes.

It begins by unleashing [b]powerful but slow attacks[/b]. Sounds easy to dodge, right? However, there’s a catch: [b]each destroyed body part[/b] triggers [b]an evolution in its combat pattern[/b], granting new abilities that are significantly faster. This dynamic creates an evolving fight, forcing you to react strategically.

[h3]Weaver[/h3]
Meet the Weaver - a small yet nasty parasitic Wraith. It performs a binding ritual to enhance its host’s power and spread the new Affliction status (available in NG+ only). Once the ritual is complete, it moves on to another host, starting the process anew. Despite its agility, the Weaver won’t attack unless provoked.

[h2]New Essence Stones[/h2]

With [i]Atlas Fallen[/i], we’ve introduced a new way to play according to your preferences, featuring cool and unique abilities called [b]Essence Stones[/b]. As you progress through the game, you’ll unlock, find, or craft these powerful stones, each granting you impactful gameplay modifiers or super-powered abilities.

[b]Reign of Sand update introduces 25 new Essence Stones[/b] to further expand your combat arsenal. Let me showcase four of them :
[list][*] Let’s start with [b]Momentum Phoenix[/b]: A new Stone that summons a [b]Tailwhipper[/b]. This creature flies toward your target, creating burning areas on the floor, damaging enemies, and generating momentum. It’s perfect for dealing with groups of wraiths, thanks to its impressive area-of-effect capability.
[*] [b]Healing Alliance[/b] is another new Stone that proves incredibly useful for both solo play and cooperative mode. It summons a friendly Mender, which follows and massively heals nearby damaged players for 15 seconds. Additionally, the Mender can sacrifice itself once to prevent your or your ally’s death. You’ll quickly grow fond of this little companion!
[*] Some newly added Essence Stones are corrupted, making you more vulnerable to damage. However, they provide strong counterparts. [b]Afflicted Overcharge[/b] is a simple yet super-effective ability. It conjures massive shockwaves around you, crystallizing all hit foes for an extended duration, immobilizing them while reducing their defense.
[*] Unleash your inner wrath with [b]Bestial Claws[/b]. This new Stone summons [b]Marauder claws[/b], allowing you to shred enemies with powerful slash attacks. You can even chain these attacks twice to perform combo maneuvers with increased damage.
[/list]
There are many more exciting new Essence Stones to discover, and we sincerely hope you’ll enjoy them!

You can learn more about Essence Stones [b]here[/b]: 

[previewyoutube=fcgCfPCTsNA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Corruption Breaches[/h2]

In the world of Atlas, the [b]Watcher [/b]is a giant floating divine structure that constantly gazes upon you, bringing forth threats and unexpected wraith ambushes during your exploration.
With [b]Corruption Breaches[/b], we introduce a [b]new open-world activity[/b]—a dynamic event that offers an intense combat experience. These challenges constantly evolve, providing you with opportunities to earn special rewards.

As you venture through the game, you’ll come across special [b]Breaches[/b]. Interact with it to reveal the type of challenge that awaits you. Each breach is influenced by [b]unique gameplay modifiers[/b], requiring you to adapt your playstyle to succeed. These modifiers set specific objectives and introduce buffs and debuffs to spice up the fight. For instance, you might experience a significant increase in [b]Momentum [/b]gain but lose the ability to perform jumps during the challenge.

As you progress through these trials, you’ll encounter many other modifiers. These intense yet rewarding combats grant you [b]materials[/b], unique [b]Essence Stones[/b], and new [b]customization options[/b].

[h2]New Game +[/h2]

With [b]Reign of Sand[/b], we aim to provide additional and meaningful ways to enjoy a new playthrough. But we’re not stopping at a simple replay!

After completing the main story campaign once, you can choose to start a new adventure in our newly-added [b]New Game + mode[/b]. Carry over all the equipment, materials, currency, and character progression you’ve already accumulated and enjoy a new super-powered playthrough.

New Game + introduces an [b]updated enemy population[/b], providing surprises along the way. Stronger, unexpected foes can now be encountered in earlier levels. Be cautious, as each of your enemies can be corrupted by the [b]Weaver[/b], a new support monster that buffs nearby wraiths with [b]Affliction[/b], causing them to deal additional special damage. If you get hit by their attacks, your health will be reduced. Defeating the Weaver quickly is crucial to increasing your chance of victory.

Additionally, NG+ brings [b]3 new armors[/b] and unique rewards, including new [b]Essence Stones[/b] to adjust your progression to the challenge. But that’s not all—we’re introducing a new [b]Weapon Upgrade System[/b] that allows you to further improve your different weapons with stronger, impactful modifiers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850092/cd10119f5fdfeb97635c27591ce07dc2d82c7ae5.gif[/img]

[h2]New Difficulty Mode “Nyaal’s Nightmare” [/h2]

Once you’ve completed the main Story Campaign, it’s up to you to increase the challenge by selecting the newly added [b]“Nyaal's Nightmare” difficulty[/b], exclusive to NG+. With an updated enemy population, this mode requires you to master all game mechanics to face even tougher foes. Alternatively, you can choose to play NG+ on the difficulty level of your choice, simply enjoying a playthrough with overpowered capacities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850092/2694031528a36932eb555a9930cc169e7aaaf5e9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Revamped First Hours and New Voice Cast[/h2]

We’ve made [b]significant enhancements to the game’s opening hours[/b] and universe introduction. Our focus has been on [b]improving pacing[/b], refining storytelling, enhancing cinematics, diversifying combat, overhauling VFX and SFX and addressing various specific areas to create an overall enhanced player experience.

With Reign of Sand Update, you’ll also encounter [b]a fresh voice cast for several characters[/b]. This includes both male and female main playable protagonists, as well as Nyall—the entity that powers your Gauntlet. With the talented support of [b]Ben Starr[/b] (known for [i]Final Fantasy XVI[/i] and [i]Warframe[/i]), who voices the male player character, we hope you’ll enjoy this new perspective on our sand-covered fantasy world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850092/a6d8bcef73612d42037c04e9a1adf6838e472148.gif[/img]

[h2]About your Game Save[/h2]

With all these additions and upgraded features, [b]we strongly recommend starting the game anew to fully experience the Reign of Sand content[/b]—even if you can carry over your current save.

Our save file transfer feature allows you to retain your character progression (level, equipment, achievements). However, please note that world progression (i.e., quest progression) will be reset to the beginning of your latest level reached

[h2]Other Significant Changes[/h2]
[list][*] Overall balancing passes for all difficulty modes ensure that all players find their preferred level of challenge. 
[*] The enemy distribution and the encounter setup has been updated to create more variety in combat challenges.
[*] Overhauled lighting setup for the character creator as well as the first level of the game to enhance the visual experience.
[*] Improved camera lock-on in combat and the introduction of two different modes to choose from.
[*] Improvement on the camera used during NPC conversations to provide a more cinematic look.
[*] Additional functionalities for mouse/keyboard controls and updated mapping to increase usability in gameplay and comfort in menus.
[*] Updated player feedback for when you leave combat and clearer communication for enemies respawning.
[*] Upgraded UI visuals for in-game menus and gameplay elements as well as additional UI elements.
[*] New option to turn on enemy outlines during gameplay for more accessibility.
[*] General bug fixing on gameplay, visual and audio issues.[/list]

We wanted to thank you all for your patience and excitement towards this release! We've put all our heart into making sure you get the best possible gaming experience. We can't wait to read and hear about your feedback on this free update! 💫

And don't forget : [i]Even in ruins, we endure. We won't let go.[/i]

notes.title: Message to our community
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

We wanted to share with you a few words about Atlas Fallen and its journey ahead.

[previewyoutube=RYVLkhaCWcU;full][/previewyoutube]

Since launch, we've worked tirelessly to improve and expand your experience, and [b]today, we have exciting news to share about the future of the game.[/b] First and foremost, we want to thank you! Your passion fuels our dedication, and we wouldn’t be here presenting what’s next for Atlas Fallen without your ongoing support and feedback.

We've closely examined your comments, delved into tons of videos and reviews to refine our vision. Since its release, Atlas Fallen has been all about fast-paced gameplay, enriched with super-powered combat moves in a unique fantasy world that players discover through cool traversal abilities.

We’re proud of what we’ve delivered and we now know where to unlock even more untapped potential!

Since launch, we've already released several patches and quality-of-life improvements to make your experience smoother and more enjoyable, but  now is the time to announce something bigger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850092/405f9fa323c3dfdc338b335c2d5548c14e5c2828.gif[/img]

Enter Reign of Sand, our next [b]upcoming major update that will vastly improve your experience.[/b] We've worked hard to bring you[b] new quests, new gameplay features, new enemies and an overhaul of your initial hours in our sun-drenched world[/b]. Most importantly, the Reign of Sand update will be completely free for everyone, whether you already own the game or not. Be ready for its release August 6, on PS5, Xbox Series X | S and PC!

Today, we're thrilled to share a sneak peek at the improvements our team is working on. New quests, new gameplay features, new essence stones, a new environment, the addition of new game plus, tweaks to the casting and writing of the main story and an overhaul of your initial hours in our sun-drenched world. 

All of it delivered [b]in August in the Reign of Sand free update![/b]

[h2]New Game+[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850092/c6fd3cd47a6dd1fd03d46dc795f2dc0a077372ad.gif[/img]

New Game+ mode brings more to enjoy beyond the main story campaign. Whether you seek more challenges or are eager to unleash your divine power. Carry over your equipment, materials, and character progression to a fresh journey on the same difficulty, with new enemies, rearranged enemy spawn, items, and weapon upgrades that help you bring an overpowered arsenal to bear. Or, challenge the full unshackled might of the Sun God in the intense experience offered by the new difficulty mode Nyaal's Nightmare. 🔁

[h2]Explore new Horizons[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850092/c97b642b8be2f46f5bbfbb9cc9c62a10ca44c2c7.gif[/img]

Along your journey, venture into the newly added [b]Source, an entangled, distorted divine plane where combat reaches a fever pitch.[/b] Harness the power of the newly introduced Wraith Abilities to transform into the very creatures that stand against you and uncover the secrets of the past in an additional quest line.

Alongside your ever-evolving weapons with their boundless array of attacks and upgrades, these new abilities provide an additional layer to combat. Mastering these abilities will be crucial to stand a chance against the new mighty boss fights awaiting in Source.

New to Reign of Sand are the Corruption Breaches scattered across the open-world. [b]These combat encounters drastically change the rules of Atlas Fallen with various gameplay modifiers to provide unique, fun and rewarding experiences.🗺️[/b]

[h2]Face new fierce adversaries[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850092/ec7ded6cc8ce7ee5830a5142c94b477444dcc63f.gif[/img]

Countless sand wraiths roam the timeless lands of Atlas, an army of savage monsters controlled by a tyrannical god. Their threat keeps humanity at bay, forcing them to hide in a few remaining sanctuaries. The RoS update expands the ranks of foes with new mighty creatures

The Morpher presents a dual challenge, forcing you to engage in combat both in mid-air and on solid ground. The Weaver is a nasty little flying critter that you will face in New Game+. It buffs nearby wraiths by applying affliction, making these foes poisonous for the player

We can’t wait to read your feedback about our new dangerous friends!

Find, upgrade and customize also your armor, uncover relics and material to increase your power and free humanity from the oppression of a tyrannical god. ⚔️

We have a save file transfer feature which allows to carry over your character progression (lvl, equipment, achievements). However, the world progression (i.e., quest progression) is reset to the start of your latest level reached.

Thanks again for your support since launch, and we hope you’re as excited as we are for this massive update!

notes.title: Learn more about the exploration in Atlas Fallen!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi everyone,[/h2]

I’m Jan Klose, Managing Director at Deck13 and working on [i]Atlas Fallen[/i]! It’s an action-RPG set in an original epic fantasy universe. On top of a [b]high-octane combat system[/b], [i]Atlas Fallen[/i] provides a [b]fascinating setting to delve into[/b], and I’m here to give you a little introduction to what you can expect exploration-wise!

[i]Atlas Fallen[/i] is set in a [b]timeless, medieval fantasy land where mankind lives under the oppression of gods.[/b] Little is known about the origins of its sand-covered world, but when our hero finds a magical gauntlet, they acquire enough power to [b]rise against the gods![/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850092/baeb1a9921b2d17bd980e8bb7729062f79470db4.png[/img]
 
Sure, combat is central to the game—the god and their hateful creatures aren’t going to fight themselves! Yet [i]Atlas Fallen[/i] also offers [b]plenty of regions to explore[/b], which will act as a nice pace-breaker in your struggle against almighty oppressors. And yes, this devastated world’s landscape is [b]dominated by vast sand deserts[/b], but you’ll also traverse a [b]wide variety of locations on top of it: hidden fortresses, corrupted forests, rare swamplands, divine cities…![/b]

Implementing such wide environments to explore led us to consider a way of locomotion other than tedious, earthbound walking and running. And given the importance of sand, we looked for a way to traverse the world which would be related to it. [b]Gliding down the dunes[/b] naturally came to everyone’s mind, [b]not only is it fast, but it also delivers plenty of sensations![/b] Sand gliding perfectly matched our vision, which is to work towards a unique aesthetic experience.

Being strictly realistic is far less relevant to us in [i]Atlas Fallen[/i] than providing an aerial and overpowering game feel, such as [b]sand—and even air—gliding[/b] allows. Exploring the vast land of the game is exalted through the[b] verticality[/b] brought by the hero’s gliding abilities. With the power of lifting buried structures endowed by the Gauntlet, there’s [b]a whole platforming layer[/b] that you can enjoy while exploring. Looking up becomes a natural part of your expeditions, [b]opening your visual experience beyond the typical field of view.[/b]

There’s a great number of [b]side activities and secret locations[/b] to support this exploratory aspect. You’ll get to[b] learn more about the land, uncover events from the past, help the oppressed population and hinder the religious devotees who take part in the tyranny.[/b] Along these quests, you’ll find divine artifacts to [b]upgrade your gauntlet.[/b] The powers to raise structures and to glide can both be upgraded, leading to new ways to explore the maps and new secrets to unveil…
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850092/c0359aa8bd9508c8164beb766a48b65772b78d13.png[/img]

I hope you enjoy the vertiginous perspective of all the discoveries you’ll be able to make in [i]Atlas Fallen[/i]! Our team looks really forward to welcoming you into this sensational world of sand!

[b][i]Atlas Fallen[/i] will release on Steam on May 16. Pre-order the game now and stay tuned for more news![/b]
